messages:
Maria Chen: Quick RFC follow-up — decided on a minimal operator-level handshake for quant profiles. Goal: let runtime negotiate fp8/int8/4bit kernels w/o per-model codegen. Draft below.
Ajay Patel: +1, can you sketch the messages? We need to be clear about fallback semantics.
Maria Chen: sketch:
```
{ "profile_id": "qp-v2", "requested_precision": ["fp8", "int8", "int4"], "quality_floor": 0.92, "latency_budget_ms": 25 }
```
Samir Rao: quality_floor is tricky — how measured? epoch-level eval vs token-level degscore?
Maria Chen: propose: baseline eval suite (1000 prompts) -> degscore per profile. Runtime exposes degscore_estimate in telemetry for live checks.
Sylvia Gomez: ops note: need a simple ABI for operator loading: symbol names + version. No heavy RPC.
DevOps Bot: Canary job started for quant-profile qp-v2 on cluster-gamma :rocket:
Ajay Patel: rollback criteria? if 2% increase in top-1 hallucination or >10% latency regress.
Eve (oncall): add an emergency flag to pin legacy int8 for specific tenant ids.
Samir Rao: agree. Also suggest a lightweight 'shadow' mode: run low-bit kernel shadowed to get metrics without impacting traffic.
Maria Chen: yep — sketching runtime flags:
```
--quant-shadow=true
--quant-profile=qp-v2
--quant-quality-threshold=0.9
```
Sylvia Gomez: question about cache format: will kv cache be compatible across precisions? we need a versioned serialization.
Maria Chen: plan: cache blob tagged with profile_id + quant_epoch. runtime refuses to use if mismatch.
Ajay Patel: also consider graceful degrade: prefer higher precision for long-tail prompts (tokenwise SNR low). How express in handshake?
Maria Chen: handshake includes optional hint: "prefer_brighter_tokens": true/false and a per-token SNR cutoff later used by scheduling.
Eve (oncall): operational checklist: rollout in 3 phases: shadow -> small canary (5%) -> ramp (50%) -> full (100%). add alerting on degscore, latency, error-rate.
Samir Rao: cc @Research-team we need to run headwise stress tests ASAP.
Maria Chen: created a tiny design doc: https://redwood.internal/notes/quant-operator-handshake (internal)
Ajay Patel: LGTM. I'll add a protobuf sketch and follow up with runtime PR.
Sylvia Gomez: can you add an explicit migration plan for on-disk cache compatibility? Ops will need a migration tool.
Maria Chen: on it. Thanks all :thumbsup:
DevOps Bot: Canary completed: 1h run, no critical alerts. See logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/logs/qp-v2-canary
Eve (oncall): leaving reminder to update runbooks and oncall playbook with the rollback criteria.
Samir Rao: flagged for research: schedule 2-day bake with shadow traces.
Maria Chen: closing thread — will convert notes to RFC follow-up doc.
